title: Planner Component

name.description: Component instance name for referencing in actions/variables

height.description: Board height; drives the vertical scroll viewport

refreshHandler.description: Named refresh channel: `- refresh: <this name>` re-runs the queries and rebuilds the board even when no query variable changed (e.g. after a mutation from an item template). Defaults to the component name.

debug.description: Log per-stage pipeline counts (extracted N -> M rows -> K columns, orphan count, resolved paths) through logger

virtualizeThreshold.description: Row count above which rows virtualise (TanStack Virtual, measured heights)

estimatedRowHeight.description: Initial row height estimate; real heights are measured after mount

name.description: Query name; rows.fromQuery references the rows source by this name

variables.description: Query variables (template expressions supported). Changing any referenced variable re-runs the query and rebuilds the board.

path.description: Plain dot-path into the response (getObj; no [] segments here)

itemsPath.description: Items sources only. Path relative to the query.path result, resolved with expandPath: every array-valued segment flat-maps automatically (no leading []; explicit [] segments are accepted no-ops). Missing/null segments yield []. Omitted -> the path result itself, normalized to an array.

parentAs.description: Items sources only. Attaches the direct owner of the final flattened collection to every item under this key (e.g. item.order).

mapping.description: Items sources only. Optional per-item template, context { ...variables, item } (item already carries the parent); result is merged over the raw item. Supply mapping.id when the entity has no id field.

queries.description: All data sources, in the useComponentQueries convention. Every query NOT referenced by rows.fromQuery is an items source; items from all items sources concatenate. The pipeline runs once after all queries resolve.

groupBy.description: Dot-path ON the item -> row key (string-coerced). null/undefined/'' -> Unassigned.

fromQuery.description: Name of the rows-source query. Rows come from it including rows with zero items. Omitted -> rows derived from distinct groupBy values in first-seen order.

key.description: Dot-path on the row record -> row key (string-coerced, must match groupBy values). Required with fromQuery.

label.description: Row label template; context: item = the row record. Default: the row key.

orderBy.description: Row sort over row fields (key, label, record.*). Default: rows-query order / first-seen order. Each entry is { field: dot-path to the sort value, direction: asc|desc (default asc) }. Multi-key and stable; null/undefined always sort last regardless of direction; ISO dates compare as dates, numbers numerically, strings locale-aware with numeric collation (natural sort, so numeric strings such as customValues sort by value).

unassigned.description: Synthetic row collecting orphan items (group key matches no row). Always renders last.

show.description: false hides the row AND logs a warning with the dropped count — items are never silently dropped

headerWidth.description: Row-header column width in px. Required: the column is sticky and virtualised rows need explicit widths to stay aligned.

headerPadding.description: Row-header cell padding in theme spacing units (1 = 4px), same idea as the top-level cellPadding but for the first column.

rows.description: Row model: grouping key on the item plus an optional dedicated rows source (visible empty rows)

orderBy.description: Sort WITHIN each row -> slot order. Item at sorted index i renders in column i. Runs after ALL sources resolve. Each entry is { field: dot-path to the sort value, direction: asc|desc (default asc) }. Multi-key and stable; null/undefined always sort last regardless of direction; ISO dates compare as dates, numbers numerically, strings locale-aware with numeric collation (natural sort, so numeric strings such as customValues sort by value).

appendEmpty.description: Always append one empty trailing slot: column count = largest group + 1 (1 when there are no items), so every lane keeps an empty cell for emptyCellTemplate / add-move affordances.

label.description: Column header template; variables: index (1-based), columnIndex (0-based)

width.description: Column width in px. Required: every virtualised row applies the same explicit gridTemplateColumns.

columns.description: Column model: ordinal slots. Column count = size of the largest group (+1 with appendEmpty); horizontal scroll, no cap.

rowHeaderTemplate.description: Row header cell; receives row { key, label, record, items, isUnassigned }, rowIndex, itemCount. Default: row.label as plain text.

itemTemplate.description: Item cell; receives item (incl. item.<parentAs> and intact nested collections — iterate them with `collection`), row, column { index, columnIndex, label }, rowIndex, columnIndex

emptyCellTemplate.description: Optional; receives row, column, rowIndex, columnIndex. Default: empty cell.

summaryComponent.description: Optional per-column footer (sticky below the viewport); receives column, columnIndex, items (that column across all rows), totalCount

emptyStateTemplate.description: Optional; shown when the pipeline yields zero items (rows from the rows query still render)

itemAccent.description: Optional per-item color template (same context as itemTemplate), usually a status color. Paints a bar down the card's left edge and a low-alpha wash of the same color over the card background. Accepts hex/rgb()/hsl() or a theme palette path ('warning.main'); anything unparseable renders the plain card.

events.description: Interaction handlers; payloads merge last over variables + store

onItemClick.description: Click on an item (propagation stopped); payload: item, row, column, rowIndex, columnIndex

onCellClick.description: Click on cell background — never fires from inside an item; payload: row, column, rowIndex, columnIndex

onRowClick.description: Click on the row header; payload: row, rowIndex

onItemsLoaded.description: Fires once per completed pipeline; payload: items, itemCount, rowCount, columnCount

cellPadding.description: Gap between the card (or empty-cell content) and the cell separators, in theme spacing units (1 = 4px). Inner card padding is the item template's own business (options.p).

isHidden.description: Boolean template expression for conditional rendering

description: Generic grouped & ordered planning grid: each resource (driver, truck, dock, crew...) is a row, its work items appear as ordinal slots across the columns (slot 1, slot 2...). Columns are positional — the item's index in its sorted group — not dates; for date/time columns use timeline-grid. Fully YAML-driven four-stage pipeline: Extract (queries + itemsPath) -> Group (rows.groupBy) -> Sort (columns.orderBy) -> Place.

query.command: query GetOrderMovesForPlanner($date: DateTime!, $branchId: Int) { orders(filter: { orderMoves: { date: $date } }) { items { orderId orderNumber orderMoves { orderMoveId startDate driver { contactId firstName lastName } orderMoveLegs { legType location } } } } }
query GetPlannerDrivers($branchId: Int) { contacts(filter: { branchId: $branchId }) { items { contactId firstName lastName } } }
